Name: Craftable Mini-Shipping Bin
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
1.6 Added the option to purchase more mini-shipping-bins from Mr.Qi, but honestly I would prefer to just make them myself!

So I've added a way to craft them! You have to have completed either the Crop Order quest or Pierre's Prime Produce and read the mail that gives you the mini-shipping bin in order to get the recipe. After that you will receieve another letter from Lewis in the mail for the recipe.

You can modify the recipe of the following 4 items for your own difficulty level! 

[b]- Wood[/b] - Automatically set at 75
[b]- Hardwood[/b] - Automatically set to 5
[b]- Iron Bars[/b] - Automatically set to 3
[b]- Solar Essence[/b] -  Automatically set to 10

To modify the recipe run your game with SMAPI, Content Patcher, and the mod installed once, then open the [CP] Craftable Mini-Shipping Bin folder and edit the generated  'config.json'

Alternatively you can also install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and do it from there!

Please enjoy!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
